title: UPPSC Computer Assistant Typing Test Exam Date 2026
vacancyDetails: Typing test exam date announced for UPPSC Computer Assistant recruitment
qualification: As per UPPSC Computer Assistant notification (computer knowledge + typing standards)
selectionProcess: Written / Screening (as applicable) → Typing / Skill Test → Document Verification → Final Merit
documentsRequired: Admit card for typing test; photo ID; registration details
howToApply:
1. Visit https://uppsc.up.nic.in
2. Open Computer Assistant Typing Test Exam Date notice
3. Note date, shift and city when published
4. Download admit card from portal when live
5. Appear with photo ID and admit card
shortDescription: UPPSC Computer Assistant Typing Test Exam Date 2026 announced. Check schedule at uppsc.up.nic.in.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has announced the Computer Assistant Typing Test Exam Date 2026.

Eligible candidates should check the official notice for date, medium (Hindi/English) and standards of typing speed. Admit cards will be available before the skill test as per UPPSC schedule.
